royalballoon.name: Cappadocia Balloon Flight
royalballoon.slogan: Dawn lifts off and the fairy chimneys fall away beneath you.
royalballoon.line: The number of balloon companies flying here nearly tripled between 2006 and 2013.

goremeopenair.name: Göreme Open-Air Museum
goremeopenair.slogan: Painted chapels carved straight into the cliff.
goremeopenair.line: Göreme National Park and the rock sites of Cappadocia were put on the UNESCO World Heritage List in 1985.

derinkuyuyeralti.name: Derinkuyu Underground City
derinkuyuyeralti.slogan: A whole town folded into the rock, eight floors down.
derinkuyuyeralti.line: Found in 1963 when a man knocked through his cellar wall, it could shelter up to 20,000 people and was sealed with rolling stone doors.

ihlaravadisiyuruyus.name: Ihlara Valley
ihlaravadisiyuruyus.slogan: Fifteen kilometres of canyon, a river and cliff-side churches.
ihlaravadisiyuruyus.line: The Melendiz River carved a gorge up to 150 metres deep that holds around 50 rock-hewn churches.

kayserikalesi.name: Kayseri Citadel
kayserikalesi.slogan: Black Erciyes basalt walls in the middle of town.
kayserikalesi.line: First mentioned on a coin of Emperor Gordian III (238-244), it was rebuilt by the Seljuk sultan Alaeddin Keykubad in 1224.
